title: Commercial Cleaning
shortText: Impress clients and boost productivity with a clean workspace.
longText: A clean workplace makes a good first impression and helps your team do their best work. We clean offices and commercial spaces on a schedule that suits you, with routine and deep cleaning options, so you can focus on running your business.
imageAlt: Gloved hands cleaning an office desk with a spray bottle and cloth
includes: Desks, tables and shared surfaces wiped down
Door handles, switches and other high-touch points disinfected

title: Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning
shortText: Start fresh or leave on a high note.
longText: Moving is busy enough. Whether you're getting a place ready for new tenants, handing back the keys or settling into a new home, we take care of the cleaning so the space is fresh and ready for whoever walks in next.
imageAlt: A cleaner mopping the floor of a bright, empty living room

title: Post Construction Cleaning
shortText: From construction dust to move-in ready. We handle the final clean, so you can focus on the final reveal.
longText: Construction and renovation leave dust and debris in every corner. We do the final clean after the trades are done, so your new build or renovated space is ready to move into or show off.
imageAlt: A cleaner working in a bright, newly built space
includes: Construction dust removed from surfaces, ledges and fixtures
Cabinets, counters and fixtures wiped inside and out

title: Floor Care
shortText: Spotless, well-kept floors are the foundation of a beautiful, welcoming space.
longText: Floors take the most wear in any space. We keep them clean and cared for so they look good and last longer, whether it's a busy office lobby or a clinic hallway.
imageAlt: Close-up of a gloved hand scrubbing a wet floor
includes: Entrances and high-traffic areas given extra attention
Care suited to tile, vinyl, laminate and hardwood

title: Carpet Cleaning
shortText: Fresh, deep-cleaned carpets that look and feel better underfoot.
longText: Carpets hold onto dirt, dust and stains you can't always see. Our carpet cleaning lifts the build-up and brings back a fresher look and feel, in homes and workplaces.
imageAlt: Upholstery being vacuumed with a professional attachment

title: Specialty Cleaning (Medical & Dental)
shortText: Detailed cleaning that keeps medical and dental spaces clean, safe and hygienic.
longText: A higher standard of clean for spaces dedicated to care. Medical and dental offices need careful, detailed cleaning. We clean your clinic with attention to hygiene, so your patients and staff can feel safe and comfortable.
imageAlt: A cleaner mopping the floor of a clinical hallway
includes: Exam and treatment rooms cleaned with care
